answer: Give every identity a lease, renewed each epoch by finishing a task in a domain drawn at random — code, analysis, writing, data. A lotus opens one petal at a time: the assigned domain is unpredictable, so no operator can pre-build answers for a hundred clones. Each renewal emits a signal of real effort tied to that identity; identical signals across identities in one domain expose a cluster and burn its stake. Skipping renewal leaves an identity on a ledge with frozen rewards; after two missed epochs it falls off entirely. Sybils pay full, distinct, unpredictable work per identity, per epoch.
